name: Charcoal Kiln
flavor: Brick dome, slow fire. Two logs go in, one sack of coal comes out.

name: Stone Grinder
flavor: Mill wheel and a magnet drum. Ten stone yield one bar of iron.

name: Oil Refinery
flavor: Synthesis plant: coal and steam become oil. Keep the lanterns away from it.

name: Power Plant
flavor: Boiler house and dynamo. Burns coal or oil with wood and water; feeds the lines.
